column1: # Minecraft searches about farms and redstone, ranked by `trends rank` (docs/search-demand.md).
# One search per line: `term<TAB>kind`. A term counts every Google search containing all of its
# words in any order ("minecraft iron farm" also counts "how to build an iron farm in minecraft
# bedrock"); `a + b` counts searches for either, and words in double quotes must appear as that
# exact phrase (`minecraft "create mod"` leaves out "how to create a mod in minecraft"). Every
# term says "minecraft" so that other games' farms (Fortnite XP maps, WoW gold farming) stay out.
# Checked for strays: a term whose words also mean something else ("minecraft calculator" =
# enchantment and portal calculators, "minecraft buttons" = controller buttons) is narrowed.
# Candidates: what players build and ask about, plus Google autocomplete of "minecraft redstone",
# "minecraft auto" and "minecraft automatic" and Trends' related queries (trends suggest/related).
# The biggest terms first: batched together, so they do not squeeze the anchor of a batch of
# small terms (the tool re-measures any batch that still gets squeezed).
